name: dsh-feishu-bridge
description: Feishu (Lark) channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): message a Feishu bot, it runs a dsh agent turn, and the reply comes back to the chat. Security-first design: fail-closed allowlist (empty allowlist rejects everyone), full webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification at the bridge boundary, one-time identity-bound card nonces, and per-chat session ownership. Supports both ws and webhook transports, sticky sessions with /new /sessions /switch commands, and installs either standalone or via dsh plugin add. Independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.
